steps.eval: (()=>{const g=__rhf.game; g.state.settings.autoQuality=false; g.setQuality('high'); g.dpr=1; g.renderer.setPixelRatio(1); g.resize(); g.bears.directorT=9999; const we=g.env.weather; we.cloud=0.25; we.cloudTarget=0.25; we.rain=0; we.rainTarget=0; we.timer=9999; g.hud.firstShown=-1000; g.hud.hint('',0); g.hud.show(false); __rhf.god(true); g.env.setTime(11); g.env.timeScale=0; g.player.tool='none'; g.viewmodel.setTool('none'); const T=g.scatter.types; window.__plant=async(type,near,dist,pitch,label)=>{const W=g.world; const t=T[type]; let bi=-1, bd=1e18; for(let i=0;i<t.count;i++){ const d=(t.x[i]-near.x)**2+(t.z[i]-near.z)**2; if(d<bd){bd=d; bi=i;} } if(bi<0) return label+': none'; const tx=t.x[bi], tz=t.z[bi]; let best=null; for(let k=0;k<36;k++){ const a=k/36*6.283; const x=tx+Math.cos(a)*dist, z=tz+Math.sin(a)*dist; if(!W.inBounds(x,z,10)) continue; const w=W.waterAt(x,z); if(w&&w.depth>0.1) continue; if(g.colliders.circlesNear(x,z,2).some(c=>Math.hypot(c.x-x,c.z-z)<c.r+0.8)) continue; const h=W.heightAt(x,z); const sc=Math.abs(h-t.y[bi]); if(!best||sc<best.sc) best={x,z,h,sc}; } if(!best) return label+': no spot'; g.player.place(best.x,best.z,Math.atan2(-(tx-best.x),-(tz-best.z))-0.15); g.player.pitch=pitch; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,4000)); return label+' '+type+' '+Math.round(Math.sqrt(bd))+' m from the place'; }; return Object.entries(T).map(([k,t])=>k+' '+t.count).join(', ')})()
